How to Sign a PDF Online Free: Draw or Type Your Signature

By the DoraPDF team · 5 min read · Updated 2026-11-11

Printing a document, signing it with a pen, scanning it and emailing it back is a twenty-minute job when you have a printer, and impossible when you do not. For most everyday paperwork you can sign a PDF online free in a couple of minutes instead, straight from your phone or laptop.

DoraPDF's Sign PDF tool lets you draw your signature with a finger, stylus or mouse, or type your name in a handwriting-style font, and stamps it onto the page you choose. Everything happens in your browser, so the document is not uploaded to a server.

When a drawn signature is enough

A signature added this way is a picture of your signature placed on the page. That is what most people mean by "sign and send back", and it is commonly accepted for:

  • Rental and tenancy forms
  • Consent and permission slips for school
  • Internship, offer and joining letters
  • Delivery notes, invoices and simple agreements between businesses
  • Internal office approvals

It is not a certificate-based digital signature of the kind some banks, courts and government bodies require, which uses an identity certificate to prove who signed. If a document says it needs a "digital signature certificate" or a specific e-signing platform, follow that instruction. When in doubt, ask the person who sent it.

How to sign a PDF, step by step

1. Create your signature Open Sign PDF. At the top is a white signing pad. - Draw it: sign with your finger on a phone, a stylus on a tablet, or the mouse or trackpad on a computer. - Or type it: write your name in the Or type it box and it appears in a cursive script. - Not happy? Press Clear and try again.

2. Upload the PDF Drop in the PDF you need to sign.

3. Choose where it goes - Page: type last (the default) or a page number such as 1 or 3. - Position: Bottom right, Bottom left or Bottom center. - Size: drag the slider. It sets the signature's width as a share of the page width, from small to half the page.

4. Sign and download Press Sign PDF, then Download. The file is saved with -signed added to its name, so your original stays untouched.

The signature has a transparent background, so it sits naturally over a signature line or text without a white box around it.

Tips for a signature that looks real

  • Sign bigger than you think. Draw across most of the pad, then use the Size slider to make it smaller on the page. A large, slow drawing looks smoother than a tiny, rushed one.
  • On a computer, a trackpad beats a mouse. Or open the page on your phone, where signing with a finger feels natural.
  • Keep it consistent. Use roughly the same signature you use on paper, so it matches your ID or earlier documents.
  • Start with the Size slider around the middle. On an A4 page, about a quarter of the page width usually looks like a normal handwritten signature.

Signing more than one page

Each run places one signature on one page. Contracts often want a signature or initials on every page, or on two separate pages. Just repeat the process:

  1. Sign the first page and download the file.
  2. Upload that signed file again.
  3. Enter the next page number and sign again.

Your drawn signature stays on the pad while the page is open, so repeating takes only a few seconds.

What if the signature line is in the middle of the page?

Sign PDF places signatures along the bottom of a page, about half an inch from the edge, which suits most letters and forms. If your document has a signature box in an unusual spot, such as the middle of a form, or you also need to type your name, date or CNIC number in fields, use the PDF Editor. There you click anywhere on a page to add text exactly where it belongs. Many people fill in the details with the editor first, then add the signature with Sign PDF.

Common problems and fixes

The signature looks shaky. Draw more slowly and larger. On a laptop, try your phone instead.

The typed signature looks like a normal font. The handwriting style depends on fonts available on your device. If it looks too plain, draw your signature instead.

It landed on the wrong page. Check the Page box. last means the final page; for anything else type the number. Sign the original file again with the correct page.

The PDF has a password. The tool tries to open protected files. If it fails, remove the password with Unlock PDF first (you need to know it).

Privacy and safety

Your document and your signature never leave your device: the PDF is opened, signed and saved by your browser. That matters, because a signature image is personal. A few more good habits:

  • Do not leave signed copies in shared folders or public chats.
  • If you email a signed contract, consider adding a password with Protect PDF and sending the password separately.
  • Read the whole document before signing. A quick tool makes it easy to sign without reading.

FAQ

Can I sign a PDF on my phone? Yes. Open Sign PDF in your mobile browser, sign with your finger and upload the PDF from your files.

Is it free? Yes. No account, no watermark and no limit.

Is a drawn signature legally valid? In many everyday situations, a signature image is accepted, but rules differ by country and by document. Some documents need a certified digital signature. Check with the person or office that asked you to sign. This is general information, not legal advice.

Can I add the date next to my signature? Use the PDF Editor to type the date anywhere on the page.
